    ⏱️ ~6 mins left to finish
    📖 0% read
    💡 Key Takeaways
    • Recent findings suggest that camunda is the enterprise platform for agentic orchestration, enabling organizations to coordinate AI agents, people, and systems across complex, end-to-end business processes.
    • Sources indicate that curious about the kind of challenges you'll work on at Camunda?
    • We are looking for a Product Builder to join the IDP & RPA pod.
    📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

    Recent findings suggest that camunda is the enterprise platform for agentic orchestration, enabling organizations to coordinate AI agents, people, and systems across complex, end-to-end business processes. With built-in governance, auditability, and human oversight, Camunda gives enterprises the control they need to move AI from pilots to production — safely and at scale. Trusted by over 700 organizations worldwide, including 9 of top 10 US banks, Camunda helps enterprises boost operational efficiency, accelerate time-to-value, and deliver better customer experiences.Fully remote and global, we are in the middle of something bigger: transforming into an AI-first organisation, built on our own platform. We use Agentic AI to automate, orchestrate intelligent processes, and elevate human contribution across every team.Named GP Bullhound’s Top 100 Next Unicorn list, 2025 Great Place to Work certified. Visionary in 2025 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Business Orchestration and Automation Technologies. ranked 3rd in Flexa's 2026 Most Flexible Companies, We’re growing fast and looking for top talent to join our team. If you want meaningful work, visible impact and put something genuinely rare on your CV, keep reading.

    Sources indicate that curious about the kind of challenges you'll work on at Camunda? Watch this quick 30-minute talk from our engineers to learn more about the latest Camunda Exporter and how we’re solving complex problems at scale.

    We are looking for a Product Builder to join the IDP & RPA pod. You will take real problems from customers, decide what is worth solving, and build and ship the solution yourself, using AI tools to get from idea to production quickly without lowering the bar.

    According to recent reports, product Building is how Camunda's Experience organization builds the applications people use on top of Camunda 8, such as Hub, Operate, and ProcessOS. Small pods of builders own a product area from customer problem to shipped change, with no hand-offs between product management, design, and engineering. We are setting this model up now, so you will help shape how it works.

    In a recent development, the IDP & RPA pod builds how Camunda processes work with documents and legacy applications. With intelligent document processing (IDP), customers create extraction and classification templates in Camunda Hub and publish them so a process can use AI to turn invoices and other documents into structured data. With robotic process automation (RPA), customers integrate legacy applications that have no APIs, using Robot Framework scripts on a standalone RPA worker. The hard problems come with putting LLMs into customer processes: extraction quality, model and prompt choices, testing and trust, and working for AI agents as well as for people.

    Help shape product direction for IDP & RPA by combining customer input, usage data, and field feedback into clear priorities.

    Partner with the other builders and product strategy to turn problems into shipped features, using short written proposals and prototypes to align early.

    Make judgment calls with incomplete information within your scope and own the outcome.

    Communicate trade-offs and decisions clearly to stakeholders who don't live in the details the way you do.

    Use AI tools across the whole loop, from specs to prototypes to production-ready code, and hold a high bar for what you ship by reviewing and improving the output rather than accepting it.

    Build, test, and ship improvements to the IDP & RPA experience, reading errors and tracing challenges far enough to give your pod useful context.

    Talk to customers and to support and customer success colleagues about how IDP is used and where it breaks, and turn what you learn into decisions about what to build next.

    Pick up customer incidents and trace them across Hub, the connectors, and the deployed process of the customer.

    Track what you ship against real outcomes and adjust when the data tells you to.

    Ability and/or willingness to use our product.

    This role is an existing vacancy.

    We offer competitive, fair, and transparent compensation. Salary ranges are location-based, with Standard and Major markets (global tech hubs) reflecting local competition.

    Industry observers note that the Annual Total Target Cash (base salary + 100% variable target, where applicable) shown below spans from the minimum in a Standard market to the maximum in a Major market. Final offers depend on skills, experience, and location, and we typically hire in the first half of the range to allow room for growth:.

    United States: $119,900.00 to $193,200.00.

    United Kingdom: £75,300.00 to £123,800.00.

    Singapore: S$148,900.00 to S$223,300.00Singapore:.

    Canada: C$127,300.00 to C$209,300.00.

    If you’re based elsewhere, you’ll be hired via Remote.com (our global employer partner), and your Talent Acquisition Partner will provide a personalized Total Rewards Calculator after your first interview.

    Equity: We also offer equity (where applicable) through our Virtual Stock Option Blueprint (VSOP).

    We invest in your wellbeing, growth, and ability to connect, along with perks that support you no matter where you’re based. Our benefits are globally designed and locally delivered where applicable.

    Remote & Flexible: Work from anywhere with the setup that suits you, home office budget, co-working space support, and flexible time off to recharge when you need it.

    In Person Connection: We invest in meaningful face time through our Annual Kickoff (Vienna in 2025, Madrid in 2026!), team offsites, and Camundi Connection Budgets, including contributing to meetups while travelling,, and local gatherings with fellow Camundi.

    Health & Wellbeing: Access locally tailored healthcare, Modern Health for global mental wellbeing, and our Live Well Lifestyle Spending Account (LSA), a flexible, global benefit that puts you in control of your whole life, not just work, from: staying active, to caring for family, exploring personal passions, meaningful experiences, and investing in your financial wellbeing. The Live Well program releases in 2026 and scales to €1,000 annually from 2027.

    Financial Security: Retirement and pension intends (often with company contributions), plus life and disability insurance where relevant.

    Professional Growth: Up to $/€/£1,000 per year for self-driven learning: courses, certifications, books, you decide!

    It has been revealed that AI in our hiring process: Camunda may use AI tools to aid the screening of applications and during the interview process. You can learn more here.

    Recent findings suggest that ”Everyone is welcome at Camunda” — it’s a celebrated component of our culture. We strive to create an inclusive environment that empowers our people. At Camunda, we honour diverse cultures and backgrounds and are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to gender, race, ethnicity, religion, belief, sexual orientation, age, disability or any other protected characteristics under applicable law. We are looking forward to your application!

    Come join us and be part of Camunda’s incredible journey: Make an impact at a pivotal moment in our story!

    Industry observers note that please be aware that scammers may impersonate Camunda by reaching out about job opportunities. Camunda will only contact candidates from an email address ending in @camunda.com or @talent.camunda.com. We will never ask candidates for bank account details, checks, payment, or other sensitive financial information as part of our hiring process. If you receive a suspicious message, please do not respond, click any links, or share personal information.

    By opting in to SMS use, please be aware that:.

    Text message frequency may vary;.

    Standard text message and data rates may apply; and.

    By opting in, you will be enrolled directly in ongoing recruiting text messages from Camunda.

    To opt-out, simply select 'No' when prompted during your application. You can also change your preferences at any time by contacting talent-operations@camunda.com.

    Head of Ecosystem at Supabase

    📅 10 Nov 2026 | ⏱️ 3 min read (571 words, 📚 Deep Dive) | Source: Realworkfromanywhere

    ⏱️ ~3 mins left to finish
    📖 0% read
    💡 Key Takeaways
    • Supabase is the Postgres development platform, built by developers for developers.
    • We're looking for a Head of Ecosystem to lead the teams that make Supabase the backend for the platforms and tools developers already use.
    • You'll also drive hiring, onboarding, and career development while maintaining high engineering standards.
    📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

    Supabase is the Postgres development platform, built by developers for developers. We aim to empower developers by providing a complete backend solution including Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime, and Vector Search. All services are deeply integrated and designed for growth.

    We're looking for a Head of Ecosystem to lead the teams that make Supabase the backend for the platforms and tools developers already use. That covers AI app builders and coding agents, integrations with the developer tools teams rely on, and the Supabase Marketplace. You'll build this org from the ground up and shape how Supabase extends beyond its own platform.

    You'll also drive hiring, onboarding, and career development while maintaining high engineering standards.

    Build and lead a newly introduced engineering org across platform partners, integrations, and Marketplace, hiring EMs and engineers as it grows.

    Own the technical relationship with the platforms building on Supabase, from integration health to escalations.

    Set and maintain clear roadmaps that balance partner needs with platform priorities.

    Partner with Product, Partnerships, and Sales to define and execute our ecosystem strategy.

    Ship a unified, self-serve surface for integrations and Marketplace.

    Maintain high engineering standards: roadmap hygiene, concern tracking, on-call, incident response, and responsiveness to partners.

    Proven experience leading multiple engineering teams, including managing other managers.

    Experience building and running platform, API, or integration surfaces that third parties depend on in production.

    Technical credibility with partner engineering teams, and the judgment to say no.

    Experience building teams or an org from a small base, including hiring and developing engineering managers.

    Strong organizational and execution skills: setting roadmaps, driving accountability, and keeping teams moving under uncertainty.

    Experience managing remote, globally distributed teams.

    Excellent cross-functional communication skills, especially with Product and commercial teams.

    Collaborative, low-ego, and adaptable.

    Have experience with OAuth, platform APIs, or app marketplaces.

    Have worked on a developer platform's partner or app ecosystem.

    Have worked with AI app builders or coding agents.

    Recent findings suggest that we hire globally. We believe you can do your best work from anywhere. There are no Supabase offices, but we provide a WeWork membership or co-working allowance you can use anywhere in the world.

    Every team member receives ESOP (equity ownership) in the company. We want everyone to share in the upside of what we’re building together.

    Use this budget to set up your ideal work environment—laptop, monitor, headphones, or whatever helps you do your best work.

    According to recent reports, supabase covers 100% of health insurance for employees and 80% for dependents, wherever you are. Your wellbeing and your family’s health are crucial to us.

    Once a year, the entire tech giant gathers in a upcoming city for a week of connection, collaboration, and fun. It’s a highlight of our year.

    In a recent development, we operate asynchronously and trust you to manage your own time. You know what needs to be done and when.

    Every team member receives an annual education allowance to spend on learning—courses, books, conferences, or anything that supports your growth.

    Supabase was born-remote and open-source-first. We believe our globally distributed team is our secret weapon in building tools developers love.

    Over $1B raised (including our $500M Series F).

    Recent findings suggest that we move fast, build in public, and use what we ship. If it’s in your project, we probably use it in ours too. We believe deeply in the open-source ecosystem and strive to support—not replace—existing tools and communities.

    We are a tech company. A gaming company. A content company. And we do it all with passion and commitment to the game. Above all we prize our mission-driven, flat, life-celebrating, no-corporate culture, and we look forward to meeting you and learning more about what you can bring to the team.

    Recent findings suggest that the Cloud Engineer role is critical to scaling Chess.com's infrastructure to support millions of daily chess games and serve global people.
